demos.text: Which components did company model AL4-140WAL21-0312 use directly (first level) on 2024-11-11 with a different quantity than in its current BOM? Return the component codes.

queries.sql:
WITH current_bom AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS current_qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'AL4-140WAL21-0312')
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
historical_bom AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS historical_qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM company_model WHERE model_code = 'AL4-140WAL21-0312')
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2024-11-11'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2024-11-11')
)
SELECT c.component_code
FROM historical_bom h
LEFT JOIN current_bom cur ON h.component_id = cur.component_id
JOIN component c ON h.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE cur.component_id IS NULL 
   OR h.historical_qty <> cur.current_qty
ORDER BY c.component_code;
queries.sql_u:
WITH direct_components AS (
    SELECT 
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        u.qty AS qty_on_date
    FROM u_composition u
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = u.child_code
    WHERE u.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND u.parent_code = 'AL4-140WAL21-0312'
      AND u.child_kind = 'component'
      AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2024-11-11'
      AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2024-11-11')
),
current_components AS (
    SELECT 
        c.component_code,
        c.name,
        u.qty AS current_qty
    FROM u_composition u
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = u.child_code
    WHERE u.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND u.parent_code = 'AL4-140WAL21-0312'
      AND u.child_kind = 'component'
      AND u.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR u.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.component_code
FROM direct_components d
LEFT JOIN current_components c ON d.component_code = c.component_code
WHERE c.component_code IS NULL OR d.qty_on_date <> c.current_qty;
queries.cypher:
MATCH (m:Model {model_code: 'AL4-140WAL21-0312'})
MATCH (m)-[u_old:USES]->(c:Component)
WHERE u_old.valid_from <= date('2024-11-11')
  AND (u_old.valid_to IS NULL OR date('2024-11-11') <= u_old.valid_to)
MATCH (m)-[u_cur:USES]->(c)
WHERE u_cur.valid_from <= date('2026-10-01')
  AND (u_cur.valid_to IS NULL OR date('2026-10-01') <= u_cur.valid_to)
  AND u_old.qty <> u_cur.qty
RETURN DISTINCT c.component_code
queries.cypher_u:
MATCH (m:Model {model_code: 'AL4-140WAL21-0312'})
MATCH (m)-[c_hist:CONTAINS]->(comp:Component)
WHERE c_hist.valid_from <= date('2024-11-11')
  AND (c_hist.valid_to IS NULL OR date('2024-11-11') <= c_hist.valid_to)
MATCH (m)-[c_curr:CONTAINS]->(comp)
WHERE c_curr.valid_from <= date('2026-10-01')
  AND (c_curr.valid_to IS NULL OR date('2026-10-01') <= c_curr.valid_to)
  AND c_hist.qty <> c_curr.qty
RETURN comp.component_code

demos.text: List the codes of all company models that contain component ASM-699-03274 at any level (directly or inside sub-assemblies) under the current BOM.

queries.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE model_components(model_id, component_id) AS (
    -- Direct components in model BOM
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        mb.component_id
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION
    
    -- Components inside assembly components
    SELECT 
        mc.model_id,
        cb.child_component_id
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component_bom cb ON mc.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT DISTINCT cm.model_code
FROM company_model cm
WHERE cm.model_id IN (
    SELECT model_id
    FROM model_components
    WHERE component_id = (
        SELECT component_id 
        FROM component 
        WHERE component_code = 'ASM-699-03274'
    )
)
ORDER BY cm.model_code;
queries.sql_u:
WITH RECURSIVE model_components(model_code, component_code) AS (
    -- Direct components of models
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code AS model_code,
        c.child_code AS component_code
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Components inside assembly components
    SELECT 
        mc.model_code,
        c.child_code AS component_code
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN u_composition c 
      ON c.parent_kind = 'component'
     AND c.parent_code = mc.component_code
     AND c.child_kind = 'component'
     AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
     AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT DISTINCT model_code
FROM model_components
WHERE component_code = 'ASM-699-03274'
ORDER BY model_code;
queries.cypher:
MATCH (m:Model)-[e:USES|HAS_PART*1..10]->(c:Component)
WHERE c.component_code = 'ASM-699-03274'
  AND all(r IN rels(e) WHERE r.valid_from <= date('2026-10-01') AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to >= date('2026-10-01')))
RETURN DISTINCT m.model_code;
queries.cypher_u:
MATCH (m:Model)-[:CONTAINS*1..6 (r, n | WHERE r.valid_from <= date('2026-10-01') AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to >= date('2026-10-01')))]->(c:Component {component_code: 'ASM-699-03274'})
RETURN DISTINCT m.model_code;

demos.text: How many units of part LEG-696-WHT-01381 are contained in one unit of the bundle SKU BDL-JP-0279 under the current BOM (through its item SKUs, their company models and all sub-assembly levels)?

queries.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE part_tree AS (
    -- Start from the target part and walk up through component BOMs to find all ancestors
    SELECT 
        c.component_id,
        c.component_id AS descendant_id,
        CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS qty_per_descendant
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.component_code = 'LEG-696-WHT-01381'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        parent.component_id,
        pt.descendant_id,
        CAST(cb.qty AS DOUBLE) * pt.qty_per_descendant
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON cb.child_component_id = pt.component_id
    JOIN component parent ON cb.parent_component_id = parent.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Get all model-component relationships for the target part (including through sub-assemblies)
model_part_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        mb.model_id,
        SUM(CAST(mb.qty AS DOUBLE) * pt.qty_per_descendant) AS part_qty_per_model
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN part_tree pt ON mb.component_id = pt.component_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    GROUP BY mb.model_id
),
-- Get item SKUs in the bundle
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        CAST(bi.qty AS DOUBLE) AS item_qty_in_bundle
    FROM sales_sku bundle
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bundle.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    WHERE bundle.sku_code = 'BDL-JP-0279'
      AND bundle.is_bundle = true
),
-- Map item SKUs to models and compute part quantity per item SKU
item_model_part AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.item_qty_in_bundle,
        sm.model_id,
        CAST(sm.qty AS DOUBLE) AS model_qty_per_sku,
        mpq.part_qty_per_model
    FROM bundle_items bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN model_part_qty mpq ON sm.model_id = mpq.model_id
)
-- Sum up total part quantity in one bundle
SELECT SUM(item_qty_in_bundle * model_qty_per_sku * part_qty_per_model) AS total_part_qty
FROM item_model_part;
queries.sql_u:
WITH RECURSIVE bom_paths AS (
    -- Start from the bundle SKU
    SELECT 
        child_kind,
        child_code,
        qty AS total_qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND parent_code = 'BDL-JP-0279'
      AND valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively traverse down the BOM
    SELECT 
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_code,
        bp.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM bom_paths bp
    JOIN u_composition uc
      ON bp.child_kind = uc.parent_kind
     AND bp.child_code = uc.parent_code
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM bom_paths
WHERE child_kind = 'component'
  AND child_code = 'LEG-696-WHT-01381';
queries.cypher:
MATCH (b:SKU {sku_code: 'BDL-JP-0279'})-[:BUNDLES]->(item:SKU)-[:MAPS_TO]->(m:Model)
MATCH (m)-[e:USES|HAS_PART*1..10 (r, n | WHERE (r.valid_from <= date('2026-10-01') AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to >= date('2026-10-01'))))]->(p:Component {component_code: 'LEG-696-WHT-01381', is_assembly: false})
WITH b, item, m, e, p, list_product(properties(rels(e), 'qty')) AS path_qty
MATCH (b)-[bundle_rel:BUNDLES]->(item)
MATCH (item)-[map_rel:MAPS_TO]->(m)
RETURN SUM(bundle_rel.qty * map_rel.qty * path_qty) AS total_units
queries.cypher_u:
MATCH (b:SKU {sku_code: 'BDL-JP-0279'})
      -[e1:CONTAINS]->(item:SKU)
      -[e2:CONTAINS]->(m:Model)
      -[e3:CONTAINS*0..10]->(p:Component {component_code: 'LEG-696-WHT-01381'})
WHERE b.is_bundle = true
  AND e1.valid_from <= date('2026-10-01') AND (e1.valid_to IS NULL OR e1.valid_to >= date('2026-10-01'))
  AND e2.valid_from <= date('2026-10-01') AND (e2.valid_to IS NULL OR e2.valid_to >= date('2026-10-01'))
  AND all(r IN rels(e3) WHERE r.valid_from <= date('2026-10-01') AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to >= date('2026-10-01')))
RETURN sum(e1.qty * e2.qty * list_product(properties(rels(e3), 'qty'))) AS total_qty

demos.text: Which 3 company models sold the most units in completed orders in country UK in 2025, counting units inside bundles? Return the 3 model codes.

queries.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE sku_model_expanded AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs map directly to models
    SELECT 
        sm.sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty
    FROM sku_model sm
    JOIN sales_sku s ON sm.sku_id = s.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs expand to item SKUs, then to models
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        sm.model_id,
        bi.qty * sm.qty AS qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON bi.item_sku_id = s.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
),
order_units AS (
    SELECT 
        sme.model_id,
        ol.qty * sme.qty AS units
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.store_id
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sku_model_expanded sme ON l.sku_id = sme.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'UK'
      AND YEAR(o.order_date) = 2025
)
SELECT 
    cm.model_code
FROM order_units ou
JOIN company_model cm ON ou.model_id = cm.model_id
GROUP BY cm.model_id, cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(ou.units) DESC
LIMIT 3;
queries.sql_u:
WITH RECURSIVE sku_to_model AS (
    -- Direct SKU to model mappings (non-bundle SKUs)
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        m.model_id,
        m.model_code,
        uc.qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = s.sku_code 
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN company_model m ON m.model_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE s.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs, then to models
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id,
        b.sku_code,
        m.model_id,
        m.model_code,
        bundle_edge.qty * item_edge.qty AS qty_per_unit
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition bundle_edge 
        ON bundle_edge.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND bundle_edge.parent_code = b.sku_code 
        AND bundle_edge.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND bundle_edge.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (bundle_edge.valid_to IS NULL OR bundle_edge.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN sales_sku item ON item.sku_code = bundle_edge.child_code AND item.is_bundle = false
    JOIN u_composition item_edge 
        ON item_edge.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND item_edge.parent_code = item.sku_code 
        AND item_edge.child_kind = 'model'
        AND item_edge.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (item_edge.valid_to IS NULL OR item_edge.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    JOIN company_model m ON m.model_code = item_edge.child_code
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
),
model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.model_code,
        SUM(ol.qty * sm.qty_per_unit) AS total_units
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN sku_to_model sm ON sm.sku_id = l.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.country = 'UK'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY sm.model_code
)
SELECT model_code
FROM model_units
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3;
queries.cypher:
MATCH (so:SalesOrder)-[:PLACED_IN]->(st:Store {country: 'UK'})
WHERE so.status = 'completed' AND date_part('year', so.order_date) = 2025
WITH so
MATCH (so)-[hl:HAS_LINE]->(l:Listing)-[:OF_SKU]->(sku:SKU)
WITH sku, sum(hl.qty) as sku_qty
MATCH (sku)-[m:MAPS_TO]->(model:Model)
WITH model, sum(sku_qty * m.qty) as direct_model_qty
OPTIONAL MATCH (bundle_sku:SKU)-[b:BUNDLES]->(sku:SKU)-[m:MAPS_TO]->(model:Model)
WHERE bundle_sku.is_bundle = true
WITH model, direct_model_qty, coalesce(sum(b.qty * m.qty), 0) as bundle_model_qty
RETURN model.model_code
ORDER BY (direct_model_qty + bundle_model_qty) DESC
LIMIT 3
queries.cypher_u:
MATCH (so:SalesOrder)-[:PLACED_IN]->(st:Store)
WHERE so.status = 'completed' AND st.country = 'UK' AND date_part('year', so.order_date) = 2025
MATCH (so)-[line:HAS_LINE]->(l:Listing)-[:OF_SKU]->(sku:SKU)
MATCH path = (sku)-[:CONTAINS*1..6]->(m:Model)
WHERE ALL(r IN rels(path) WHERE r.valid_from <= date('2026-10-01') AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to >= date('2026-10-01')))
WITH m, sum(line.qty * list_product(properties(rels(path), 'qty'))) AS total_units
RETURN m.model_code
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3
